task_language: put the bottle in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
strategy_notes: Localized bottle, drawer floor, handle, and cabinet body from agentview/wrist back-projection. Recipe steps 1-3 moved above the bottle and attempted a deliberately short scripted drawer-face contact; step 4 used only 4 chunks of trained close to create a shallow partial closure while preserving the cavity. Step 5 returned neutral. Step 6 used the verbatim task prompt and produced the retained bottle grasp; step 7 firmed it. Steps 8-10 lifted high, carried upright over the cavity, and descended to base support. Steps 11-13 performed support-assisted yaw +1.57, pitch +1.40, then yaw +1.57; back-projection after step 13 showed the bottle axis across world x. Step 14's position-only +y advance stalled. Step 15 co-varied pitch/yaw with move_pose and crossed the y wall to the cavity. Step 16 descended to support. Step 17 released, and step 18 retreated open. Step 19 used the trained insertion prompt to seat the released bottle deeper. Step 20 used the trained close prompt and fired libero_terminated=true.
